explanation: Compared against OEIS A229232, Sun's conjecture (1), second part: for any n > 0 with n ≠ 4 there is a permutation π of 1..n with all cyclic 2π(i)π(i+1)+1 prime. The statement uses π ∈ Perm (Fin n) with values shifted by +1 and cyclic successor (i+1) mod n. For n = 1 the single self-pair gives 3, consistent with the circular reading. Faithful.
